features.name: url_structural_integrity
features.description: Averaged score of URL structural features to provide a continuous measure of URL legitimacy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, linearly separable composite feature that helps the SVM establish a clear margin based on URL characteristics.

features.name: domain_registration_trust
features.description: Composite index of domain registration and DNS features, representing the overall trustworthiness of the domain.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple sparse domain signals into a single continuous vector, improving linear projection.

features.name: connection_security_index
features.description: Measures the strength of the connection security by averaging SSL, HTTPS, port, and request URL states.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous severity measure for connection security, allowing the SVM to weight security posture effectively.

features.name: page_content_safety
features.description: Evaluates the safety of the page content by combining indicators like iframe usage, popups, and right-click disabling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dimensionality of highly correlated HTML/JS features into a single robust margin feature.

features.name: external_reference_reliability
features.description: Assesses the reliability of external references by averaging anchor URLs, tags, and form handler states.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized score of external link integrity, which is a strong linear predictor for web safety.

features.name: web_reputation_index
features.description: Combines traffic, page rank, and search index presence into a continuous reputation score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms discrete reputation flags into a smooth continuous feature, ideal for linear decision boundaries.

features.name: core_trust_signals_average
features.description: An unweighted average of the most critical trust signals across different domains (SSL, anchors, prefix/suffix, traffic, subdomains).
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a strong primary linear projection that captures the most variance in site legitimacy.

features.name: ssl_domain_mismatch
features.description: Calculates the absolute difference between the SSL state and the subdomain state to identify inconsistencies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a non-linear interaction (absolute difference) as a linear feature, helping the SVM capture specific mismatch anomalies.

features.name: js_obfuscation_risk
features.description: Identifies the worst-case scenario among JavaScript-based obfuscation techniques (mouseover, right-click, popups).
features.expected_model_benefit: Uses a minimum function to create a strict threshold feature, allowing the SVM to penalize any single severe JS obfuscation.
